entities.name: Amadou M’barick Fall
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Amadou Louis M'barick Fall, known as Battling Siki, was the first African-born boxing world champion. Born in French-Senegal, he won the world World Light-Heavyweight Championship after knocking out Georges Carpentier in 1922.
